package collector

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"io"
	"os/exec"
)

func PinEvasionSWEPTCOPY(ctx context.Context, dir string) int {
	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, "git", "-C", dir, "ls-files")
	swept, err := startSweptCommand(cmd)
	if err != nil {
		return 0
	}
	defer swept.Close()
	var b bytes.Buffer
	_, _ = io.Copy(&b, swept.Stdout)
	return b.Len()
}
